vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_D256
vars.desc: Master switch for the D256 attention kernels. 0 = the stock path end to end (bit-identical), for A/B and troubleshooting.
vars.desc_zh: D256 注意力的总开关。0 = 整条走 stock 路径（逐位一致），用于 A/B 和排障。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_D256_Q4_DIRECT
vars.desc: Read q4_0 K/V as raw blocks inside the prefill kernel: drops the f16 mirror (~470 MB/card at 229k) for ~4% slower prefill.
vars.desc_zh: 预填充侧 q4_0 K/V 核内直读，省掉 f16 mirror（229k 约 470 MB/卡），代价约 4% 预填充。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_D256_Q8_DIRECT
vars.desc: Same for q8_0 K/V (bit-identical to the staged mirror); ~9% slower prefill at 174k. For VRAM-tight setups.
vars.desc_zh: q8_0 K/V 核内直读（与 staged mirror 逐位一致），174k 预填充慢约 9%；显存吃紧时才用。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_D256_DECODE
vars.desc: Decode through the D256 tensor-core kernel. It only pays for speculation widths w>=2; w=1 stays on the stock path.
vars.desc_zh: 解码走 D256 张量核心 kernel。只有投机验证宽度 w≥2 才有收益；w=1 仍走 stock。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_D256_DEC_Q4
vars.desc: q4_0 direct loads in the decode kernel (no mirror traffic per step). Independent of the prefill Q4_DIRECT switch.
vars.desc_zh: 解码 kernel 的 q4_0 直读（省掉解码期的 mirror 读写）。与预填充的 Q4_DIRECT 各自独立。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_SKINNY
vars.desc: k-quant repack. 0 off; 1 in-place (+10% prefill, -28% decode); 2 side-buffer copy (+9% prefill, decode unchanged, a second copy of the weights in VRAM). Also the gate for IQ_SKINNY.
vars.desc_zh: k-quant 瘦身。0 关；1 原地重排（+10% 预填充、解码 -28%）；2 侧缓冲副本（+9% 预填充、解码不变，多一整份权重显存）。也是 IQ_SKINNY 的前提。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_IQ_SKINNY
vars.desc: Repack the IQ types too: +2-3% prefill for +7.3% VRAM. Only does anything when the model has IQ3_S/IQ3_XXS/IQ2_XS/IQ2_S tensors and SKINNY != 0.
vars.desc_zh: IQ 类型一并重排：预填充再 +2~3%，代价 side buffer +7.3% 显存。仅当模型里存在 IQ3_S/IQ3_XXS/IQ2_XS/IQ2_S 张量、且 SKINNY≠0 时有效。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_DEQUANT_FAST
vars.desc: sm_70 dequant kernels for iq3_s / iq3_xxs / iq4_xs. Bit-identical to the stock kernels (there is a parity gate).
vars.desc_zh: sm_70 快速去量化（iq3_s / iq3_xxs / iq4_xs），与 stock 去量化逐位一致（有 parity gate）。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_GDN_CHUNK
vars.desc: Chunked GDN prefill path (gated_delta_net.cu). 0 disables it.
vars.desc_zh: GDN 分块预填充路径（gated_delta_net.cu）。0 = 关闭。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_SPLITKV3_MIN_KV
vars.desc: SplitKV3 kicks in once kv_len reaches this value; 0 disables it. Below 2048 there is nothing to split.
vars.desc_zh: kv_len ≥ 该值时启用 SplitKV3 三路切分；0 关闭。低于 2048 的长 KV 用不上三路并行。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_D256_SPLITS
vars.desc: Cap on decode KV splits. 0 = automatic (kv_len/920, up to 48); maximum 256.
vars.desc_zh: 解码 KV 切分上限覆盖。0 = 自动（kv_len/920，上限 48）；最大 256。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_GDN_PROLOGUE
vars.desc: GDN l2norm prologue fusion (bit-exact). Off by default: the A/B quoted in the source is slower with it on.
vars.desc_zh: GDN l2norm prologue 融合（逐位精确）。默认关：源码注释里的 A/B 是 ON 更慢。

vars.name: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
vars.desc: Built from the device switches above (SM70 cards only, CUDA index order).
vars.desc_zh: 由上方设备开关自动拼出（只含 cc 7.0 的 SM70 卡，按 CUDA 序号）。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_ALLREDUCE
vars.desc: Allreduce implementation. Unset = NCCL on Linux and the built-in one elsewhere (Windows); the fork's P2P path lives in the built-in one.
vars.desc_zh: 多卡 allreduce 实现。未设时 Linux 用 NCCL、其他平台（Windows）用内置实现；本仓库的 P2P 路径是内置实现的一部分。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_P2P_ALLGATHER
vars.desc: P2P allgather (enabled when unset or non-zero). 0 falls back to the default allgather.
vars.desc_zh: P2P allgather（源码按“未设或非 0 即启用”）。0 = 关闭，回落到默认 allgather。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_P2P_AR_MAX_BYTES
vars.desc: Message window for the single-shot P2P allreduce (default 176 MiB, ~704 MB of VRAM across two cards). 0 disables the path.
vars.desc_zh: 单发 P2P allreduce 的消息窗口（默认 176 MiB，两卡约 704 MB 显存）。0 关闭该路径。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_P2P_AR_NBLOCKS
vars.desc: Allreduce block count (default one per SM). More than one per SM can deadlock.
vars.desc_zh: allreduce 的 block 数（默认每 SM 一个）。超过每 SM 一个会死锁。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_P2P_AR_LL_MAX_BYTES
vars.desc: Byte ceiling for the low-latency allreduce (default 128 KiB); larger messages take the single-shot window.
vars.desc_zh: 低延迟 allreduce 的字节上限（默认 128 KiB）；更大的消息走单发窗口路径。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_P2P_AR_LL_PAYLOAD
vars.desc: Payload compression for the low-latency allreduce. Non-zero changes the result (rounding); 0 keeps the values.
vars.desc_zh: 低延迟 allreduce 的载荷压缩。非 0 会改变结果（有舍入），默认 0 = 原样。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS
vars.desc: Disable CUDA graphs (troubleshooting; usually much slower).
vars.desc_zh: 禁用 CUDA graph（排障用，通常会明显变慢）。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_GRAPH_CHUNK_SIZE
vars.desc: Nodes per CUDA graph chunk; 0 captures the whole graph as one.
vars.desc_zh: 每个 CUDA graph chunk 的节点数；0 = 整张图捕获成一个 graph。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_GRAPH_OPT
vars.desc: Graph optimization switch (only 1 enables it).
vars.desc_zh: graph 优化开关（仅 1 启用）。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_MMQ_PREC
vars.desc: Override the mmq src1 precision (f32/f16/auto). auto keeps what the graph asked for.
vars.desc_zh: 覆盖 mmq 的 src1 精度（f32/f16/auto）。auto = 保留图里请求的精度。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_CUBLAS_COMPUTE_TYPE
vars.desc: cuBLAS compute type (fp32/fp16/bf16/tf32...). auto leaves it to the backend.
vars.desc_zh: cuBLAS 的计算类型（fp32/fp16/bf16/tf32...）。auto 交给后端决定。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_PDL
vars.desc: Programmatic Dependent Launch (on when unset or non-zero; needs build support).
vars.desc_zh: Programmatic Dependent Launch（未设或非 0 启用；需要编译期支持）。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_DEVICES
vars.desc: Physical devices exposed to the backend (e.g. 0,1). The device switches above are usually enough.
vars.desc_zh: 显式选择暴露给后端的物理设备（如 0,1）。一般用上方的设备开关就够了。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_ENABLE_UNIFIED_MEMORY
vars.desc: Enable unified memory (changes VRAM behaviour, usually slower).
vars.desc_zh: 启用 unified memory（会改变显存行为，通常更慢）。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_FUSION
vars.desc: Disable operator fusion (troubleshooting).
vars.desc_zh: 禁用算子融合（排障用）。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_NO_PINNED
vars.desc: Disable pinned host memory (saves system RAM; troubleshooting).
vars.desc_zh: 禁用 pinned host 内存（省系统内存 / 排障用）。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_AR_COPY_THRESHOLD
vars.desc: Byte threshold for the copy path in the built-in allreduce (default 1 MB).
vars.desc_zh: 内置 allreduce 里“走拷贝路径”的字节阈值（默认 1 MB）。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_AR_COPY_CHUNK_BYTES
vars.desc: Copy chunk size for the built-in allreduce; 0 = heuristic (512 KB - 2 MB).
vars.desc_zh: 内置 allreduce 拷贝分块大小；0 = 按启发式（512 KB ~ 2 MB）。

vars.name: GGML_CUDA_AR_BF16_THRESHOLD
vars.desc: Message size below which bf16 compression is used (default 1; 0 disables). Changes results.
vars.desc_zh: 小消息用 bf16 压缩的阈值（默认 1；0 关闭）。会改变结果。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_D256_DEBUG
vars.desc: Print the D256 kernel selection probe (ACCEPT/REJECT + reason). First decision per class by default.
vars.desc_zh: 打印 D256 kernel 的选择探针（ACCEPT/REJECT + 原因）。默认只打每类第一次决策。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_IQ_PARITY
vars.desc: At the first repack, dequantize one tensor of each type through the side buffer and through the stock kernel, then compare value by value and print nbad.
vars.desc_zh: 首次 repack 时，把每个类型的一个张量分别用侧缓冲展开和 stock 去量化，逐值比对于 host 并打印 nbad。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_SKINNY_DEBUG_STOCK
vars.desc: Debug split: 1 forces IQ types onto the original path, 2 forces k-quants (0 = no intervention).
vars.desc_zh: 调试切分：1 = IQ 类张量强制走原始路径，2 = k-quant 类走原始路径（0 = 不干预）。

vars.name: LLAMA_SM70_STEP_PROF
vars.desc: Per-round / per-subgraph wall-clock ledger (P0, ggml-backend-meta.cpp).
vars.desc_zh: 逐轮/子图的墙钟账本（P0，ggml-backend-meta.cpp）。

vars.name: SM70_DUMP
vars.desc: Dump attention outputs to this path. Unset = zero overhead.
vars.desc_zh: 把注意力输出抓到文件（路径）。不设即零开销。

vars.name: SM70_DUMP_KV
vars.desc: Dump the D256 kernel's Q/K/V inputs to this path for offline reproduction.
vars.desc_zh: 把 D256 kernel 的 Q/K/V 输入抓到文件（路径），供离线复现。

vars.name: SM70_DUMP_MAX
vars.desc: How many times SM70_DUMP may fire (default 4096).
vars.desc_zh: SM70_DUMP 最多抓多少次（默认 4096）。
